# Addresses

Part of the **Partners** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List addresses

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/addresses`

Retrieve a paginated list of addresses for a specific partner with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `partner_id` | integer | Yes | The partner ID |


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: creator | `creator` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[sub_type]` | string | No | Filter by address type |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by address name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[city]` | string | No | Filter by city (partial match) |  |
| `filter[country_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of country IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[state_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of state IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[trashed]` | string | No | Filter by trashed status. Available options: with, without, only |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `name` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/addresses?include=creator&sort=name&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]

  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/addresses?include=creator&sort=name&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

## Create address

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/addresses`

Create a new address for a specific partner

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `partner_id` | integer | Yes | The partner ID |



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `sub_type` | string | Yes | Address type. |
| `name` | string | Yes | Address name or label (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `email` | string | No | Email address (max 255 characters). Must be a valid email address. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `phone` | string | No | Phone number (max 20 characters). Must not be greater than 20 characters. |
| `mobile` | string | No | Mobile number (max 20 characters). Must not be greater than 20 characters. |
| `street1` | string | No | Street address line 1 (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `street2` | string | No | Street address line 2 (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `city` | string | No | City (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `zip` | string | No | Postal/ZIP code (max 20 characters). Must not be greater than 20 characters. |
| `state_id` | integer | No | State ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `country_id` | integer | No | Country ID. Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/addresses" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "sub_type": "invoice",
  "name": "Main Office",
  "email": "office@company.com",
  "phone": "+1234567890",
  "mobile": "+1234567890",
  "street1": "123 Main Street",
  "street2": "Suite 100",
  "city": "New York",
  "zip": "10001",
  "state_id": 9,
  "country_id": 233
}'
```

## Force delete address

<Badge type="tip" text="DELETE" /> `/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{partner_id}/addresses/{id}/force`
